info.name: DeadlineHub API
info.description:
Postman API testing collection for DeadlineHub RESTful APIs (Experiment 7).
Structured with subfolders (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) for Deadlines and Announcements, covering positive and negative edge cases (200, 201, 400, 401, 403, 404).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints: user registration, login with JWT issuance, and authenticated user profile retrieval.

request.description: Register a new user account (student or teacher). Passwords are securely hashed with bcrypt.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 201 Created or 409 Conflict if already registered", function () {
pm.test("User object returned without password or hash", function () {

request.description: Authenticate an existing student user. Saves token to {{studentToken}}.

exec: pm.test("Student JWT token returned and saved to environment", function () {

request.description: Authenticate an existing teacher user. Saves token to {{token}} and {{teacherToken}}.

exec: pm.test("JWT token returned and saved to environment", function () {

request.description: Retrieve current authenticated user profile using JWT token.

exec: pm.test("Profile contains user info without password", function () {
